captions.detailed: A compact, palm-sized camcorder designed with a matte black finish. It features a main rectangular body with rounded corners, a protruding front lens barrel containing a dark glass lens element, a rounded handgrip on one side, and a flip-out rectangular side monitor on the opposite side. The side monitor is mounted near the rear and rotates outward on a vertical hinge, while a detailed lens ring is fitted on the front barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a palm-sized camcorder with a rounded handgrip, a short front lens barrel, and a flip-out side monitor near the rear. The side monitor should rotate outward on a vertical hinge, and the lens ring on the barrel should rotate continuously.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining the main body as a rounded box extrusion. A cylindrical lens barrel is added to the front, and a textured lens ring is created using polar arrays of small rectangular notches subtracted from a cylinder. The side monitor is modeled as a flat box attached via a vertical hinge joint, and the handgrip is created as a rounded box on the opposite side.
